name: Ant Reschedule

function.name: initiate_customer_reschedule
function.description: Texts customer 3 A/B/C reschedule options. Always call when they agree to receive the text.

destinations.message: Connecting you with Teddy, our owner. One moment.
Connecting you with our office. One moment.

firstMessage: Hey {{customer_first_name}}, this is Ant from TN Appliance Exchange — wanted to give you a quick call. We have to push your {{appliance_type}} repair from {{original_time_human}}. Reason is {{reason_short_human}} — really sorry about that. Want to get you set up with three new times that work?
voicemailMessage: Hey {{customer_first_name}}, this is Ant from TN Appliance Exchange. We had to reschedule your {{appliance_type}} repair from {{original_time_human}} — {{reason_short_human}}. I'm texting you three new times right now — reply A, B, or C, or call us back at six-one-five, eight-five-seven, eight-eight-zero-zero. Really sorry about this.
endCallMessage: Thanks for being flexible. Talk to you soon.
